# Lekya Specs (lekya.in) Full Knowledge Base Specification

> Full Technical & Architectural Specification for AI Agents, LLM Search Crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Bing Copilot).
> Domain: https://lekya.in

## Company Profile & Brand Metadata
- **Legal Entity**: Lekya Specs (Lekya Group)
- **Primary Domain**: https://lekya.in
- **Industry**: Eyewear, Prescription Optics, E-Commerce, AR Technology
- **Founder & Development Team**: Built and engineered in New Delhi, India.
- **Headquarters Address**: 102-J (part of 102), Hari Nagar Ashram, South Delhi, New Delhi - 110014, India
- **Customer Support Phone**: +91 96541 19262
- **Support Email**: support@lekyaspecs.in

## E-Commerce Technology Stack
- **Frontend Framework**: Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, HTML5, WebGL/Three.js 3D Try-On
- **Backend Infrastructure**: Node.js, Express.js REST API
- **Database Engine**: Turso Cloud Database (LibSQL / SQLite)
- **Payment Gateway**: Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, NetBanking, COD)
- **Logistics Integration**: Parcel Uncle Live API & Courier Uncle Aggregator
- **Media Optimization**: Cloudinary CDN

## Key Online Features & Page Routes
- `/` — Homepage featuring 3D Hero, Trending Frames, Face Shape Curation.
- `/shop` — Catalog with real-time filters (Category, Gender, Frame Shape, Price Range).
- `/tryon` — 2D & 3D AR Virtual Try-On Studio with live webcam & face mesh tracking.
- `/face-shape` — Face Shape Analyzer tool.
- `/lens-guide` — Interactive prescription lens index & anti-glare coating selector.
- `/track` — Live order tracking engine.
- `/api/google-shopping-feed.xml` — Google Merchant Center RSS Feed.
- `/sitemap.xml` — Google Image & URL sitemap.
